name: levenshtein
description: Edit distance between two strings (single-character insert/delete/substitute) (C++). WHEN TO USE: fuzzy "did you mean" matching — comparing a possibly-mistyped tool name, file path, or identifier against known candidates. Input: {"a": "...", "b": "..."}. Capped at 2000 characters per side.
llm_description: Edit distance (insert/delete/substitute) between strings a and b. For fuzzy "did you mean" matching. Capped at 2000 chars per side.
